description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a small lump of blue slime (with a tiny white piece embedded in it) near the center, and a small clear plastic container off to the left. The left hand and right hand come in to make the slime a two-hand object, pressing it together, then pulling their hands apart to stretch it into a long thin strip before folding and bunching it back into a compact lump and repeating the stretch-and-fold kneading, ending with both hands releasing it back onto the table.
